systems.owner: NITA-U with Posta Uganda; Ministry of Public Service for the national rollout; World Bank funding for the centres
systems.tiers: regional centre at the Posta Uganda premises in Gulu city, more than 40 workstations for ministries and agencies (URSB, URA, NIRA), due by June 2026; similar centres in Mbarara, Kampala and Tororo; Hoima the only operational site for the last three years; said to be going to integrate Gulu district local government operations

note: A one-stop shop of national agencies (class central, out of scope); the report says the centre will integrate Gulu district local government operations but states nothing about the district's own office or its connection.
